description: Open-source single Go binary that turns a SQL database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, Snowflake) into a REST API and MCP server with RBAC, OpenAPI 3.1 and an admin UI.
rules: Send the API key in the X-API-Key header for /api/v1/* and /mcp.
REST paths are /api/v1/{service}/_table/{table}; the combined OpenAPI 3.1 spec is at /openapi.json.
Use include_count=true (not count=true) to get a total record count.
Prefer the built-in /mcp endpoint with a read-only role; stdio `faucet mcp` runs with admin rights.
Connect databases with host/port/user/password (faucet db add --host --user --password --database); --dsn is optional.
Row-level filters on role rules are stored but not enforced yet; do not rely on them for isolation.
